_note: Cohort registry read by src/download_tcga.py, src/build_cancer_drivers.py, src/preprocess_exact.py, src/train_exact.py, src/report_exact.py and src/plot_exact.py. The BRCA / LGG / KIPAN entries reproduce the settings used before this file existed. To add a cohort: add an entry with its TCGA project(s), raw-data folder per project, label source, class order, transformer-stream attention heads and driver-list rule. Label types: 'xena_clinical' (column of the Xena <PROJECT>_clinicalMatrix.tsv), 'file' (table of patient id -> subtype), 'project' (class = TCGA project; for merged cohorts such as KIPAN). The 5 cohorts below are the ones used in the final results (results/final_ensembled_streams); the earlier entries brca, brca_pancan and ucec were removed on 2026-11-03.

labels.source: cBioPortal lgg_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018 SUBTYPE (as the reference graph method)

drivers.oncomir_note: all (pan-cancer list; no LGG normals in OncomiR)

labels.source: PAM50: cBioPortal brca_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018 SUBTYPE; patients without it take Xena BRCA_clinicalMatrix PAM50Call_RNAseq (column 'source' in the label file)
cBioPortal coadread_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018 SUBTYPE, all 8 values as separate classes (as the reference graph method, Table 1: 8 classes)
cBioPortal stad_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018 SUBTYPE, 5 classes (as the reference graph method, Table 1: 5 classes)
